scenarios.name: logged drives are append-only: everyone reads them, but no member can insert, edit, or delete one with raw SQL

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_driving_log__drives (id, driver_id, supervisor_id, date, minutes, night_minutes, weather, road, notes, created_by, created_at) VALUES ('d1', ?, ?, '2026-01-05', 45, 15, 'clear', 'city', 'First city drive', ?, '2026-01-05T18:00:00Z')
SELECT id, minutes FROM app_driving_log__drives
SELECT id FROM app_driving_log__drives

INSERT INTO app_driving_log__drives (id, driver_id, supervisor_id, date, minutes, night_minutes, weather, road, notes, created_by, created_at) VALUES ('d2', ?, ?, '2026-01-06', 600, 600, 'clear', 'highway', 'x', ?, '2026-01-06T18:00:00Z')
UPDATE app_driving_log__drives SET minutes = 600 WHERE id = 'd1'
DELETE FROM app_driving_log__drives WHERE id = 'd1'
SELECT id, minutes FROM app_driving_log__drives

scenarios.name: neither party can forge a countersignature or an adult void note through raw SQL

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_driving_log__drives (id, driver_id, supervisor_id, date, minutes, night_minutes, weather, road, notes, created_by, created_at) VALUES ('d1', ?, ?, '2026-01-05', 45, 0, 'clear', 'city', '', ?, '2026-01-05T18:00:00Z')
INSERT INTO app_driving_log__certifications (id, driver_id, supervisor_id, driver_attested, supervisor_signed, status, updated_at) VALUES ('d1', ?, ?, 1, 0, 'pending', '2026-01-05T18:00:00Z')
UPDATE app_driving_log__certifications SET supervisor_signed = 1, status = 'locked' WHERE id = 'd1'
SELECT id, status, supervisor_signed FROM app_driving_log__certifications
INSERT INTO app_driving_log__notes (id, drive_id, kind, body, created_by, created_at) VALUES ('n1', 'd1', 'void', 'mistake', ?, '2026-01-06T00:00:00Z')
SELECT id FROM app_driving_log__notes

scenarios.name: a teen sees and edits only their own hours goal; an adult sees and sets every driver's

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_driving_log__goals (member_id, total_minutes, night_minutes, updated_at) VALUES (?, 3000, 600, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'), (?, 3600, 600, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')
SELECT member_id, total_minutes FROM app_driving_log__goals
UPDATE app_driving_log__goals SET total_minutes = 1 WHERE member_id = ?
SELECT member_id, total_minutes FROM app_driving_log__goals WHERE total_minutes = 3600
UPDATE app_driving_log__goals SET total_minutes = 3300 WHERE member_id = ?
SELECT total_minutes FROM app_driving_log__goals
UPDATE app_driving_log__goals SET total_minutes = 2400 WHERE member_id = ?
SELECT member_id, total_minutes FROM app_driving_log__goals
